package service_test

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/app/internal/service"
	"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
)

// scenario for service_tests_import_gin: Service-level tests that depend on Gin when the service contract is supposed to be transport-neutral.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.
func TestGetProfile(t *testing.T) {
	gin.SetMode(gin.TestMode)
	w := httptest.NewRecorder()
	c, _ := gin.CreateTestContext(w)
	c.Request = httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/profile/42", nil)
	c.Params = gin.Params{{Key: "id", Value: "42"}}

	repo := &mockProfileRepo{}
	svc := service.NewProfileService(repo)
	svc.GetProfile(c)

	if w.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Errorf("expected 200, got %d", w.Code)
	}
}

type mockProfileRepo struct{}

func (m *mockProfileRepo) FindByID(ctx interface{}, id string) (service.Profile, error) {
	return service.Profile{ID: id, Name: "Test User"}, nil
}
